notes: The PDF holds two forms: page 1 is FDP Form 10b Goods and Services bid-out ("FIRST QUARTER CALENDAR YEAR 2019", prepared by Cleofe A. Amores, BAC Secretariat); page 2 is a civil works bid-out ("1ST Quarter, CY 2019", submitted by Rhodora P. Ortega, Engineer III). Page 2 header prints "Looc" under "Republic of the Philippines".
goodsServices 18-09-2023: ABC printed "P 800,000,00" (comma in place of decimal point); transcribed as 800,000.00.
goodsServices 18-11-2768: ABC printed as "4,000,000" without centavos, overflowing from the description cell.
goodsServices 9-01-0209: reference number transcribed as printed; its first character appears cut off on the scan (likely "19-01-0209").
Address "Pelaez, St., Cebu Ctiy", "Panay Ave. South Triangel, Q.C" and descriptions "I unit Operatin Room Table" are spelled as printed.

civilWorks: the No. column is printed but blank for every row (values null). Rows 18-72 to 18-75 print the same bid amount 1,986,951.94 as 18-71 although ABCs differ widely (e.g. 18-73 ABC 70,613,769.00; 18-75 ABC 1,499,999.00, below the bid); transcribed as printed.
civilWorks 19-10: bid amount printed "33,896,,138.44" (double comma); transcribed as 33,896,138.44.
civilWorks row 19-04 is very faint on the scan; values read from a 7200px re-render (ABC 335,436.00; bid 333,418.06).
Contract durations transcribed as printed, including inconsistent spacing ("245C.D.", "120C.D.").

bidderNormalized: a canonical spelling added by the transcriber so the same company ranks as one bidder across documents (case, punctuation and obvious misspellings unified, e.g. variants confirmed by the bidder name repeated in the address column or by an identical contact person/address). The printed name is kept unchanged in bidder.
